plan.notes: Term-by-term sequence transcribed verbatim from the official Ashland University 'B.A. Psychology (minor required – this guide assumes an 18 hour minor) FOUR YEAR CURRICULUM GUIDE' (Department of Psychology; Revised September 2024). 8 semesters x 15 credits = 120 credits. Placeholder slots (CORE, CORE/CCI, PSYC ELEC, PSYC CON, MINOR, ELECTIVE) are choice:true with the guide's own slot labels as codes and catalog-worded choice_notes. The Year 3 Fall research slot is an either/or: PSYC 310 Advanced Research OR PSYC 393 OR PSYC 498. CCI footnote preserved: 'The Critical Cultural Inquiry (CCI) requirement can be completed by either one value-added foreign language course, an approved study-away or study abroad experience, or one CCI course. One slot should be allotted for CORE/CCI, but students completing the requirement with study abroad can substitute an elective, if necessary, to reach 120 hours. If students are continuing a language study, it is preferable to take the course during the first semester of the first year.' Prereqs are not stated on the 4-year guide and are therefore omitted. tccns mirrors the local course code (non-Texas school). transfer_confidence is 'core_only'.
